versions.changelog:
Initial release: structured management tool for auditor qualification and competency matrices.

- Supports structured capture and centralized management of auditor qualification and competency evidence.
- Generates plain text (.txt) and Markdown (.md) qualification matrix and maintenance plan reports.
- Enables role-based workflows for system managers and audit program administrators, with clear separation from exam/score reviewer functions.
- Handles qualification status tracking, expiry warnings, evidence collection, and annual maintenance planning.
- Does not fabricate data—missing information is clearly flagged for enterprise completion.
- Built-in with standard rules and categories for major audit types, qualification levels, and maintenance requirements.
